rmi lam la rang bzhin gang yang med/ rmi lam du rmi lam gyi dge sbyor nyams su blang snyam du bsam/ de nas sngon 'gro snga ma ltar byas la/ sngar gyi dmigs pa de snying gi dbus su yar spos la bsgom/ snying khar 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa dang*/ rmi lam la rmi lam du shes par bya snyam pa gnyis ka dus gcig zung 'jug tu bsgom/ de la rmi lam zin nas rmi lam du dge sbyor nyams su len pa dang sbyang ba gal che gsung*/ gnyis pa'o// 'di rmi lam gyi thon chos lags pas spyir rmi lam 'dzin pa 'di la/ nyin par sgyu lus bsgom pa gal che/ de nas srod gung gi bar du yang bsgom/ 'di la yang zin na zin par byed pa'i rgyu lnga/ ma zin na ma zin pa'i skyon lnga gsungs pas/ mos gus yod na zin/ dam tshig yod na zin/ gdams ngag dang dran pa dang 'dun pa sngar gyi goms shas che na zin/ grib can dang bsten grogs ma byas na zin/ de la mos gus med na mi zin pas/ spyir dkon mchog dgos bla ma dam pa la mos gus bya/ de yang bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed cing mos gus gsha' ma byed dgos pa yin/ de la mos gus yod kyang ma zin na dam tshig med pas lan pa yin pas/ spyir theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi dam tshig mtha' dag bsrung dgos/ sgos gsang ba'i rten 'brel lus la gnas pa'i dus su zin pa la tshegs med pa lags/ de gnyis yod kyang ma zin na gdams ngag gi gnad med pas lan pa yin pas/ nyin par la sogs pa sgyu lus gsha' mar bsgoms pas zin pa yin/ de gsum yod kyang ma zin na dran pa dang 'dun pa shas chung bas lan pas nyin par srod dang*/ gung la sogs pa'i bar du sgyu lus rkang chogs par bsgom/ de ltar sgyu lus bsgom pa'i sngon du yang chos thams cad rmi lam lta bu yin/ rmi lam la rang bzhin gang yang med/ rmi lam du rmi lam gyis dge sbyor nyams su blang snyam du dran pa dang 'dun pa sngar bas kyang shas che ba bsgom pa yin/

de ltar byas kyang ma zin na grib can dang bsten nas 'grogs pas lan pa yin pas/ 'dzem pa gal che/ grib la de tsam gyi skyon yod dam snyam na/ grib che bas rang gi bar chad byed/ 'bring pos dge sbyor gyi bar chad byed/ chung bas kyang na tsha sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bar chad mang po 'byung ba yin pas 'dzem par bya'o// de yang slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ don rnams kun la mi 'gal ba'i// ngan pa rnams ni 'jing sring na// go 'phang mtho yang brlag par 'gyur// srin bu dra ba'i khar phyin 'dra// gsungs pas/ grib can dang bsten 'grogs mi byed pa gal che/ gzhan yang gnas kyi grib dang*/ zas grib/ gos grib la sogs pa spangs nas gong du ji ltar snyan du gsol ba bzhin bsgoms pas/ zin pa la tshegs med pa lags/ de yang rmi lam 'di shin tu zab pa lags pas/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni 'phags pa dgra bcom kun la yang 'di med pa lags/ 'di la rje rin po che yang thugs rtsis shin tu che bas/ nan chags chen po nyams su blang*/ 'di la rmi lam bzung ba dang*/ sbyang ba dang*/ bsgyur ba dang*/ bslab pa/ de kho na nyid bsgom pa dang bzhi yin/ de la rmi lam bzung ba ni/ bla ma dam pas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du nyin par sgyu lus bsgom pa la sogs thams cad la zer ba yin/ sgyu mar bslab pa ni nam srod dang gung la sogs par sgyu lus bsgom/ mtshan mo rmi lam 'od gsal bsgom pa de la sgyu mar bslab par gsung*/ de kho na nyid bsgom pa bya ba ste/ nyin par gyi dge sbyor rmi lam du 'drongs pa byung na de kho na nyid bsgom/ yang na shes pa gsal la dwangs pas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la phril gyis 'gro bar byung na/ de kho na nyid bsgom/ de ltar bsgoms pas de ltar bsgoms pas shes pa rtsub pa dang*/ 'khrugs pa 'tshig pa za ba sogs byung na/ rmi lam zin 'dod pa'i rtags yin pas/ sngar bas kyang brtson 'grus che bar byas la bsgom/

zin nas kyang gcig nas gnyis su bsgom pa la sogs pa spel zhing sbyang gsung*/ de yang rmi lam thun cig zin na/ rnal 'byor zla phyed bar du 'tsho ba yin/ de la yang dper na/ bung bas sbrang rtsi len pa dang 'dra ste/ bung ba gzhan thams cad kyis me tog gi bcud mang po bsags kyang bag tsam las mi yong la/ ma des me tog 'ga' bkab pa tsam gyis sbrang rtsis khengs pa dang 'dra bar/ gtum mo la gnad du bsnun pas/ de las yon tan bag tsam las med kyang sgyu lus gzhi bzhag yin pas/ rmi lam 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag gis yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyud la skye ba yin gsung*/ bag chags kyi sa bon thams cad dag par byed pa la/ rmi lam 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag 'di bsgom pa yin/ bag chags kyi sa bon ma dag na/ bag chags kyis mtshams sbyar ba'i nyon mongs pa mi dag pas/ 'di theg pa gzhan pas khyad du 'phags pa yin te/ 'phags pa dgra bcom pa kun kyang 'di med pas/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho ba la sogs pa 'byung ba 'di la goms pa byas pas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rmi lam du shes/ rmi lam bag chags su shes/ bag chags gdod ma nas zhi bar shes/ des glo bur gyi dri ma thams cad 'dag cing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'gyur ro// de ltar sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par 'gyur ba rnam pa gsum po 'di dus rgyun chad med par nyams su blangs pas sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor 'gyur/ rang gzhan thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas par byed pas gdams pa rmi lam khrid kyi rim pa'o// chos drug gi khrid des thon pa lags/ bsngo ba re mdzod// rdo rje 'chang chen 'bri gung pa'i// gdams ngag thabs lam chos drug 'di// brjed tho tsam gyis bris pa lags// bla ma mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na// bzod par bzhes la byin gyis rlobs// gzhan la spel na nyams par 'gyur// dge ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis pa// 'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par shog/

// 862) ༄// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po'i lo rgyus bsdus pa// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan srung dpal nag po chen po 'di/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mngon tu byas te/ shrī nā len+d+ra'i bstan srung du bskos so// nag po chen pos kyang de'i bya ba mdzad de mu stegs kyi ston pa ma khol gyis bstan pa la gnod pa byas pa la/ mgon po nyid kyis bdag bya rog tu sprul nas 'ong ba'i mgul du phrin gyi yi ge thogs shig /lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la slob dpon yab sras gdan 'dren du 'gro'o zhes dge 'dun gyis thugs su chud par byas pa las/ dge mdun gyis kyang de ltar byas te/ mgon po bya rog tu sprul pa de nyid dpal gyi ri la gshegs nas/ slob dpon yab sras kyi gtor btegs kyi steng du babs te skad bton pas/ slob dpon yab sras kyis rig ste/ yi ge'i don rtogs nas/ slob dpon ār+ya de ba byon nas/ mu stegs kyi ston pa ma khol btul te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod pa med par byas so// des na ye shes kyi mgon po de nā len+d+ra nas/ dpal gyi ri la bya rog tu sprul te byung bas/ bya rog ma zhes pa'i mtshan yang thogs skad/ yang las kyi mgon po de ni bya rog gi gdong pa yod pas bya rog gdong zhes brjod do// de nas bla ma rdo rje gdan pa las mi nyag gi yul du sku 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa chen po dngos grub brnyes pa'i bla ma rtsa mis mngon du gyur te/ dbang rab tu thob nas las sbyor rnams gsungs so// de nas bla ma dpal chen po la chos skyong du gnang ste/ bu bzhin tu skyong bar gyur pa yin no// khyad par du las kyi mgon po bsil ba'i tshal na bzhugs te/ rten rdo sku rang byon zhig yod do// de'i drung du bla ma dpal gyis bsgoms pas nyams tshad du dngos su byung nas bla ma la 'dzings pas/

bla mas kyang skad gcig gis tshar bcad/ dbang du gyur nas su yin dris pa la/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i 'khor yin gsungs skad/ der bla mas kyang me tog snal ma'i phreng ba zhig kyang byin/ bstod thung de yang mdzad nas bla ma la shin tu glo nye bar gyur nas/ rgya gar nas bya rog gdong can bla ma dpal gyi phyi la 'brangs te bod tu song zer ba tsam du bla ma la 'khor ba yin skad/ gdams ngag kyang ma lus pa bla ma rtsa mi nyid kyis bla ma dpal la gnang ste/ khong gis bod nas gser srang bco brgyad bla ma la 'bul du btang ba la/ rtsa mi'i zhal nas/ yang na 'bul ba che ste/ nged gnyis ka rnal 'byor pa yin pas 'di ltar mi dgos/ yang na chung ba yin te nga rgya gar gyi mi chen zhig la/ kho bod kyi mi chen zhig gis 'bul ba yin zhes zhal ta yang mdzad skad/ de'i dus su las sbyor gyi yi ge thugs las phyung ba yang mdzad nas skyes lan du gnang ba yin te/ yi ge de dag ni blo gtad pa'i gnas su gyur pa ste/ ma nor ba rnyed pa dag gis mig gi 'bras bu bzhin gces par 'dzin par rigs so// de las gzhan pa'i spros pa mang po ni yi ge'i tshogs su bas te spros pa la dga' ba dag gis 'dod/ de ltar gdams pa dang grub pa 'dzoms pa'i bla ma dpal la/ bla ma a sing gis zhus/ de la rin po che mtha' rtsa bas zhus te/ zhal rtag par gzigs pa dang*/ bu bzhin tu skyong ba dang*/ 'bangs bzhin du 'khol ba dang*/ rab tu grub pa'i gtam rgyud yid ches pa mang du yod de/ 'dir mi spro'o// de la bdag gis zhus te/ spyir yang bla ma'i slob 'bangs sgrub pa po rnams la nye bar gtod/ dgon pa dang 'khor 'bangs rnams la 'khor zhing skyong la khyad par du bdag gi chos skyong du rmi lam du ngo sprad nas mos pa byed pa tsam mod/ de dag ni nyams su len cing sgrub pa'i chos la nyams myong dang byin rlabs su 'dzom zhing*/ sgrub rgyud bar ma chad pa gnad du che bas 'di la de dag dang ldan te/
bsgrub na the tshom med par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'byung ba'i lo rgyus zur tsam yin no// bstan pa phyogs bcur skyong ba'i bkris shog// /

863) ༄// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po'i gsang sgrub skor gsum// rgya gar skad du/ ka wu pā wa pa ma hā kā lā gu h+ya sā tā na na mo// bod skad du/ bya rog nag po gsang ba'i sgrub thabs/ dpal khrag 'thung bya rog nag po la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas gzhung dang mthun par ri bo ma mo dur khrod dang sngags dam tshig shad mtshams dam par bcad/ gtor ma 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma bshams/ rgyun gtor bshams sems bskyed bya/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das lhan cig skyes par bsgom/ bzlas pa bya/ de'i ngang las 'di nyid dpal nag po chen por gyur pa'i yul du bsgom/ de'ang pad nyi dang ro'i gdan steng na/ dpa' bo'i stangs stabs kyi zhabs gnyis bzhugs pa/ phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po'i gri gug gis g.yon gyi thod khrag thugs kar dkrug pa'i tshul du bsnams pa/ g.yas 'og ma ral gri rin po che 'bar ba bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma kha ṭ+waṃ ga keng rus kyi yu ba byas pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba la thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ sku mdog mthing nag tu 'jigs pa/ stag gi sham thabs can phyag rgya drug dang dbu rgyan/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan/ gdu bu/ mchod phyir thogs/ thal chen dang drug go/ /sbrul rigs lnga dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang ldan pa/ mgo lnga bcu'i do shal yod pa/ me dpung chen po'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom par bya'o// de'i spyi bor tsakra klad pa'i nang rus pa'i mgo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin lce'i rtsa ba par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ thugs nang gi hūm̐ dang srog rtsa'i rgyab tu kar rdo rje sngon po/ rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po gnas par bsgom par bya'o// phyogs thams cad nas rang dang 'dra ba dpag tu med pa phyag bzhi pa mang po zang zang byon nas nag ring nge 'dug par

byon nas rang la thim par bsam par bya'o// de nas rang gi srog rtsa'i nang du nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ nag po mtshon gang pa ri zur la mi langs pa lta bu nag ring nge 'dug pa snying gangs dkar gyi steng na tshur la yang ha brgyan pa'am/ gsum pa bzhengs nas g.yon du 'khor bar bsam mo// de'i ngang las ma yengs par/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu pā wā pā ma hā kā lā yā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ wa pa zhes bzlas par bya'o// de ltar nyams su blangs la thun mtshams su gtor ma btang*/ mchod pa dang bstod pa tshul bzhin du bya'o// dpal chen po rga los dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du mdzad pa rdzogs so// : bsngo ba bya'o/ /dpal bya rog nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal rga los mdzad pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis yod / thun mong pa ni gzhung gzhan du gsal/ dpal khrag 'thung 'gro ba'i mgon po thun mong ma yin pa 'di la don rnam pa ka'u pa'i bskor gsum gsum ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi tsakra gsum las/ dang po sku'i don bdun te lha bskyed pa dang*/ bya rog chu dang chu 'dres pa ltar nyams su blang ba dang gcig bya rog snying nang du yi ge bsgom sgrub thabs dang gnyis/ lus dang grib ma rang gi snying rten du 'jug pas gtor ma mi 'chag pa yin bzhin du 'ong ba'i gnad dang gsum*/ spyi bo haṃ nag po bde chen gyi 'khor lo la brten nas bde ba chen po ltar sgrub pa dang bzhi/ mgrin pa ra bya rog sgom longs spyod kyi tsakra la brten nas gnod sbyin ltar sgrub pa dang lnga/ snying ga nang du yi ge bsgom pa yin chos kyi 'khor lo la brten nas 'od gsal du sgrub pa dang drug lte ba lte bar bya rog bsgom sprul pa'i tsakra la brten nas gtum mo ltar sgrub pa dang bdun no/ /gsum pa don rnam pa lnga ste gsang sngags la rim/ sku'i bsnyen mahā ka la hūm̐ phaṭa: gsung dang

ka wu pa/ thugs badz+ra mahā ka la ya dang*/ yon tan gur+ṇa hri dang*/ 'phrin las bsnyen pa bzhi gcig tu bsgril ba gal che'o dang*/ de'i las mdun du bya rog ma ma byams bzhi ni gzhung na gsal lo// thun mong ma yin pa 'di la yi ge gnyis dang gsum gyi gnad zhal las shes/ khyad par can de la bya/ dga' spro byas nas nyams su blang*/ thugs kyi sems yi dam lha bya rog gsum las gsum ste/ sems gsum bskyed rims kyi gnad la zer gnad du btang ba dang gcig /dwangs ma'i srog nyams su blang ba'i gdams ngag dang gnyis/ zhe gnag pa'i tshul gyis bsgral bar bya snyam pa dang gsum/ /yi dam lha dang dbyer med par bsgoms pa sku'i dam tshig gi rgya/ rgyun par bzlas pa gsung gi dam tshig rgyun gtor ma chag pa dam rdzas kyi dam tshig spyod pa gang yin yang ma yengs pa thugs kyi dam tshig gal te nyams na bshags pa dang bskang ba bya'o// de ltar rtags dpag tu med pa bshad kyang*/ zhal dngos su mthong ba rab yin/ mi 'gyur ba'i rtags bya rog yin/ ldog pa'i rtags nges par 'khor rgyu med pa yin/ shin tu gsang ba gal che'o/ /zhag bdun na zhal lta bar byed pa 'di la don gsum ste/ phyi'i 'khor lo la brten pa dang*/ nang gi 'khor lo la brten pa dang*/ rgyab kyi gnad yig gnyis pa bcug la/ gnad bco lnga'i bzlas pa gnad du 'gro ba gal che/ phyogs thams cad nas rang dang 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byon nas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'dus te/ snying gi dwangs ma'i srog la bstim pa gal che/ nang gi 'khor lo ni/ snying rnams bsgoms pas bcas ni/ phyi'i tsakra ni 'dzin gtor gyi bcas yin te/ sa'am shing las sa dbus su gru gsum g.yas g.yon du gsum dang bzhi bya'o// yang na pad+ma 'dab gsum lte ba dang bzhi bya'o// de nas dbus su gtor ma che ba zhig bzhag gzhan de las chung ba la mnyam pa bzhi bzhag byin rlabs ni rlung me sbud sbar gyis dbul/ dbu ma'i thad ka'am/

steng gi nam mkha' la gdan gsum/ steng na lhan skyes dang bya rog dbyer med par bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i mdun gyi gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkha' la nag po stong gis bskor bar bsgom/ g.yas pa seṅge'i gdong can la sha za 'bum gyis bskor bar bsgom/ g.yon du dmar mo rtsa 'jib ma la ma mo bye bas bskor bar bsgom/ mi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ yang de rnams kho na 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byon nas de rnams la thim zhing rgyun du bzhugs par bsgom/ zhag bdun zer yang zla ba'i ming yin te/ dus kyi bsnyen pa rab zla ba gcig 'bring zla ba gsum/ tha ma zla ba gcig byed pa yin/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni rab 'bum gcig gnyis/ 'bring gcig bzhi/ tha ma bdun byed pa yin/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa ni/ rab dngos su zhal mthong*/ 'bring nyams snang la mthong*/ tha ma rmi lam la yid ches pa'i bzang ltas sna tshogs rmi ba yin rdzogs so// dpal rga lo'i thugs bzhed kyi bcud zhal gyi gdams pa las/ las sbyor mi dgos pa shin tu gsang bas bka' rgya yod/ : maṅga laṃ/ bha wan+tu/ shu bhaṃ// // 864) ༄// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po'i thugs sgrub// dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma dpal gyis dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du nag po chen po zhal gzigs nas/ nag po chen po nyid kyis srog gi snying po phul/ bstod pa mdzad pa'i dus su sgrub pa'i thabs 'di thugs la 'khrungs pa lags skad/ de'i zhal yi dam nag po chen pos lung bstan pa/ las dang skal bar ldan pa yis// rgyal ba 'byung bar lung bstan pa'i// bsod nams snying po'i rnal 'byor khyod// nga yi thugs kyi sprul pa yi// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar mdzod// ces gsungs so/ gyi gdams pa 'di la gnad rnam pa bzhi ste/ gsang ba rten gyi gnad/ bskyed rim go zlog gi gnad/ bzlas pa srog gi gnad/ nag po chen po lus dang grib ma bzhin du mi 'khor ka med kyi gnad dang bzhi'o// de la dang po gsang ba rten gyi gnad/

yi ge nas bshad pa'i phyi rten nang rten la sogs pa rnams gnad mi che ste/ gsang ba rten gyi gnad 'di ma shes na nag po chen po dbang du mi 'du/ gnyis pa bskyed rim go bzlog gi gnad 'di ma shes na sgrub pa la bogs mi thon/ gsum pa bzlas pa srog gi gnad ma shes na nag po chen po mi 'grub pa yin/ bzhi pa lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa'i gnad ni/ tsakra bzhi rdzas rnams bcang bar bya'o// dpal nag po chen po dbang du bsdu zhing las nyan pa gsang rten gyi gnad yin pas gsang rten lus la bcang ba gal che bas zhal las shes par bya zhes pa ni/ de la gsang ba rten gyi bcas ni rang he ru ka yab yum du bsgom pa'am dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgoms pa'i gsang gnas su chos 'byung gru gsum sngon po zhig bsgom/ de'i nang dbus su dpal nag po chen po chags pa'i yum dga' byed dbang phyug ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal cig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas dang po na ral gri'am gri gug /gnyis pas tshangs pa'i mgo bo khrag 'dzag pa bsnams pa/ g.yon dang po na tsit+ta/ gnyis pa na mda' gzhu bsnams pa'o// de'i gsang ba'i gnas su yab kyi sa bon hūm̐ nag po bsam/ 'di rtag tu bsgom mi dgos/ dam tshig tu nyin lan gsum/ mtshan lan gsum tsam du dran par bya/ sgrub pa'i dus su grangs mang du bsgom/ gnad 'dis nag po chen po dbang du 'du zhing las nyan pa yin pas gsang rten lus la bcang ba 'di gal che'o// bzlas pa srog gi gnad la/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa 'di mgon po spyi'i snying po yin/ 'dis nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa mi 'grub pas/ sgos kyi srog snying btags nas bsgrub na zhal myur du mthong*/ ma mthong yang rtags myur du yong ngo*// de nas rang lhan skyes su bsgom/ mdun du nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa sgrub thabs ltar bskyed la/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu pa ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ ki na shwa ra snying kha rag tsit+ta srog la dung dung*/ dun dun/ breng breng*/ dza dza hūm̐/ ces nus tshad bgrang ngo*// de nas sgrub pa'i tshe mtshams dam par bcad/ smra gcad byas la/ gtor ma kha yar la bstan nas bskul bya/ de'ang zhag bdun phrag dang po la rkang pa brgyad pas bstod pa bya/ bdun phrag gnyis pa la slob dpon nag po pas zhal gzigs pa'i bstod pas bstod/ bdun phrag gsum pa la bsil ba tshal mas bstod/ bskyed rim nag po chen po yi ma thub na sras su bka' nyan par bsams la sgrub par bya'o// des dbang du 'dus nas bka' mi nyan mi srid do// de ltar bsgrubs kyang rtags bul bar byung na/ shin tu go bzlog gi bskyed rim ni/ rang he ru kar bsgoms nas de'i thugs kar rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de'i lte ba'i nang du nag po chen po bsgoms la bsgrub na myur du 'grub bo// bzhi pa lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa'i gnad ni/ de yab yum go bzlog tsakra gsum dang bzhi'o// de kha sprad pa'i nang du rta nag gi snying dum cig khyi nag gi snying dum sna rtse/ pad+ma rak+ta/ mi'i snying dum cig la phud*/ nya'i snying*/ rgya spos dang bdun no// rang he ru kar bsgoms pa'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ mthing nag cig mdun du byon par bsgom/ de nyid rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsams/ de yongs su gyur pa las nag po chen por bsgom/ rang he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis dpral bar oṃ dkar po zhig byung nas nag po chen po'i dpral bar zhugs/ yang rang gi smin mtshams nas he ru ka tshon gang pa zhig byung*/ oṃ gyi steng du byon/ skus byin gyis brlabs nas sku dbang du 'dus par bsam/ rang gi mgrin pa nas āḥdamar po he ru ka dmar pos gsung byin gyis brlabs nas dbang du 'dus/ yang snying ga nas hūm̐ mthing nag he ru ka nag pos thugs byin gyis brlabs/ dbang du 'dus par bsam mo// de ltar bsgoms pas rang gi sku gsung thugs nag po'i sku gsung thugs om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis sbrel la bsgrub par bya'o// de nas rmi lam dang dngos su rtags byung nas rbad na nag po zhal phyir bstan la bsnyen pa bskyal lo// de ltar byas kyang 'grub tu ma btub na/

nag po he ru ka'i mdun du spyi gtsug tu bsgom na mi 'grub mi srid do// de ltar sgrubs kyang rtags ma byung las byed du ma btub na rang mgon po chen por bsgom/ dpal he ru ka mdun du bsgom la rang gis phar la bka' nyan par bsams la sgrub par bya'o// des dbang du 'dus nas bka' mi nyan mi srid do// de ltar bsgrubs kyang rtags bul bar byung na/ shin tu go bzlog gi bskyed rim ni/ rang he ru kar bsgoms nas de'i thugs kar rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba'i nang du nag po chen po bsgoms la sgrub na myur du 'grub bo// bzhi pa lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa'i gnad ni/ de yang yab yum go bzlog gi 'khor lo gsum dang bzhi'o// de bzhi kha sprad kyi nang du rta nag gi snying dum cig /khyi nag gi snying rtse sna rtse/ lce rtse dang pad+ma rak+ta/ mi snying dum cig skyes pa grir shi ba'i snying rtse/ la phud/ nya'i snying*/ rgya spos dang bdun bya rog gi snying shun du bcug la/ rin po che sna lnga sman a mṛ ta/ dar dmar pos bsdams la mis ma mthong bar mchan khung g.yon du dar nag tu btum la lus la bcang ngo*// des nag po chen po lus dang grib ma bzhin 'gyur ro// de ltar ye shes mgon po 'grub na las mgon rang bzhin gyis las byed de/ rgyal po dbang du 'dus pa'i blon po'am 'bangs dang 'dra'o// las mgon thod nag ltar byas kyang chog de ltar sgrubs nas nyams su blangs pas rab kyis zhag bdun na zhal mthong*/ 'bring gis nyi shu rtsa cig tha mas kyang zla ba gsum na zhal mthong ngo*// mthong lugs la gsum ste/ rab dngos su mthong ba/ 'bring gis sgra dang thug chom du byung na/ ha ha hi hi krung krung trung trung hūm̐ hūm̐/ ces sgrub khang du 'byung ngo*// tha ma'ang rmi lam du byon nas dngos grub ci 'dod zer nas sngar gyi sgra sgrog pa 'byung ngo*// de ltar grub pa la chos gsum dang ldan dgos te/

he ru ka la bsnyen pa grangs sam/ rtags la sogs pa sngon du song nas/ bla ma la gus pas gdams ngag la yid ches pa/ de ltar bsgrubs nas las mgon dgra la kha bstan pa tsam gyis chog gsung ngo*// de nas las mgon thod nag ltar byas kyang cung bskul dka' ba byung na yang*/ 'di ltar gsal bar bya ste/ rang he ru kar gsal bar bsgom/ mdun du nag po chen po bsgoms la de gnyis kyi bar du las mgon spyi gtsug tu bsgom/ dpal chen po gnyis kyi thugs ka nas rang gi sngags kyi 'od zer dang bcas pas/ kho'i lus dkris pas kho rang dbang med par 'dar cug cug yod pas che ge mo khyur khyur zos par bsam zhing*/ dpal chen gnyis kyis sngags kyi bar du las mgon gyi sngags bcug la bgrang bas rmi lam mam mngon sum du rtags 'byung*/ der dar sna lngas dril la/ tshon skud sna lngas rgya gram du bcings la dar dmar pos dril lo/ dus der kha bsgyur bas chog /gnad kyi gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams shin tu gsang ba'o// bka' rgya yod/ dpal khrag 'thung gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// tsakra'i bsrung ba ni/ dar nag la bya rog gdong can gyi gzugs mtshal dang bya rog gi khrag gis bris la/ de'i thugs kar e gru gsum bri/ de'i dkyil du hūm̐ gi mtha' ma srog snying gis bskor/ ro ras la kā li nag mo'i gzugs shig 'bri/ de'i dkyil du muṃ smug nag gcig 'bri mthar ma mo'i srog snying gis bskor/ de'i mtha' mar pad+mas bskor ba bya'o// yang nag po phyag bzhi pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ las snying po'i mtha' ma srog snying gis bskor/ de'i mtha' ma rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor bar bya'o// de nas rab gnas btab la lus la bcang ngo*/ // 865) ༄// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po'i dam tshig thugs kyi sgrub thabs// dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ye shes mgon po lcam dral sgrub pa'i thabs 'di la don gsum ste/

phyi sgrub dang*/ nang sgrub dang*/ gsang sgrub gsum las/ dang po phyi sgrub ni gnas dben zhing nyams dga' ba yid du 'ong bar dam tshig dang sdom pa dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dang po bka' sdod du bsgrub pa 'di bya ste/ pū dza dang ba ling legs par bshams te/ rang nyid dpal lhan skyes su bsgoms pa'i mdun du mgon po bsams la/ khyad par du bla ma 'di'i lugs kyi gnad rnam pa lnga ste/ sku mi 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir bskyed pa'i cho ga ni/ rang lhan skyes kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pa las mdun du pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan steng du hūm̐ nag po 'phros pa las rdo rje gri gug yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhig bsams/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bstan pa la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad bsgral nas tshur 'dus pas hūm̐ rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes mgon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sku mdog mthing nag spyan gsum pa phyag g.yas pa be ta'i 'bras bu/ gnyis pa ral gri/ g.yon dang po thod pa khrag gis bkang ba/ 'og ma na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rin po che dang*/ rus pa dang*/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i skur bsgom/ de nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la mchod bstod byas la bstim mo// nus pa mi nyams par bya ba'i phyir/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa brtan pa ni/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag gsum bsams la thun 'go thams cad du oṃ āḥhūm̐ brgya rtsa brgyad lan gsum bzlas so// nag po chen po sgrub pa'i dus su snang srid kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad dang sbrel nas sgrub pa'i gdams ngag ni/ dpal nā lan+d+ra dang*/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas spyan drangs pa'i dus su mgon po dang lha mo dpag tu med pa lha ma srin sde brgyad dang bcas pa spyan drangs la bstim pa'o// dngos grub myur du thob par bya ba'i phyir ting nge 'dzin gyi byed pa las phrin las bzhi la zhi ba la sngags kha dog dkar po/

rgyas pa la ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ drag po la nag po/ mtshan ma nye bar bya ba'i phyir sngags kyi byed pa bstan pa la/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kā lā hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ spyir sgrub pa'o/ /khyad par du nang gi sgrub pa la rang nyid ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi par bsgom/ lhan skyes dbu thog tu yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa thugs kar bsgom mo// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa

yi ge bcu pa'o / da ni gsang ba srog gi sgrub pa thun mong ma yin pa la gnas ni brag nag po/ bya rog tshang can lho nub tu bltas pa'o// gtor ma 'bru nag po la byas pa'i sha chen gyis brgyan pa dpal 'khor can bya'o// srog gi gnad bzhi las/ dwangs ma'i srog phyag rgya chen po'o// gnas pa'i srog yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag 'od 'phro ba'o// gdags pa'i srog la sngar gyi sngags de tsho'i steng du yi ge bcu gsum pa ste/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu pa mahā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'di bya rog can gyi snying po thun mong ma yin pa'o// 'khrul pa'i srog ni yi ge tri ser po bsgom pa 'di ni drag po mngon spyod kyi srog dang cho 'phrul gyi dus su dgos so// dang po zhal nye bar lta ba la bsnyen pa'i man ngag zhag bdun mar grags pa la myur du bskul ba wu pa/ zhes 'jug pa/ tshig so 'jug pa'o// mdun du bskyed la sku 'dar ba dang*/ 'dar bar sgom mo// oṃ badz+ra bde mchog ka wu pa mahā bya rog gdong can kā lā ya ye shes mgon po hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'o// ka li ya 'jug pa ni sgrub pa'i dus su 'jug pa'o// las sbyor dus su 'jug pa ni 'khrul pa'i srog 'jug pa ste su tri ya ma du dza/ mahā kā la su tri ya ma du dza: las mgon gyi sngags 'jug pa yin no// las mgon gsum gyi sngags ni/ oṃ mahā kā lā gu ṇa hri da hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kā lā trag shad dza/ oṃ mahā kā lā sid+dhi ya ma du dza/ tri ser po sgom dus su mdun du ye shes pa dang las mgon gsum ga 'dar ba gnad che'o// bskyed rim go bzlog gi gnad ni/ rang nyid ye shes mgon po lhan skyes lte ba'i nang du las mgon gsum gyi gri gug thod pa can 'jigs su rung ba gsum mdun du gsal ba la/ rang gi sa bon las 'od 'phros pas khong dbang du 'dus par bsam/ ye shes mgon po la 'khor ḍā ki ma brgyad yum tsaṇ+ḍi ka dang bcas pa'i gsang sgrub kyi sngags ni/

oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ kā li mahā kā li tsa mu tri kam ka li/ ra ga ta pa ta na/ bhak+ṣa ni ya ma ka se/ sarba na dhi stam+bha ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ sngags kyi gnad ni/ snga ma de rnams dang las sbyor dus su bzhi snying gcig tu sbrel ba yin/ gsang rten gyi gnad ni dam rdzas mi snying dmar po de gsang rten thun mong ma yin pa'o// zhes so// gtor ma de nyid kyang mgon po'i pho brang dang*/ 'dod yon lnga rang chas su tshang bar gnas/ gzhan yang skyes pa grir shi ba'i snying rtse dum bu dang*/ 'khor lo gsum dang bcas pa rten gyi tshul du sba bar bya'o// de lus la bcangs pas lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa'i gnad yin/ thod pa'i 'phreng ba srin med pa 'phreng ba'i mdo 'dzin bla ma yi dam dbyer med pa'o// gnyis pa 'phreng ba de mgon po'i sku brgya rtsa brgyad du sgom pa yin no// byin gyis brlabs te sku gsung thugs kyi bsnyen pa 'gro bas lam du byed pa shin tu zab pa yin no// gdong can gsum gyi sgrub pa la mchod gtor bzang du bshams te/ gtor ma de dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu bsams te phul/ de nas mdun du ye shes mgon po yab yum dang bcas pa dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas nag po stong*/ sha za 'bum/ spyan drangs nas bstim/ de dbang bskur ba'i dus kyi dmigs pa dang gcig pa yin no// dgos su sgrub pa la mi bsad pa'i mtshon las byas pa'i gri gug dang*/ phur bu sor bzhi pa gal che'o// las kyi mgon po las ma nyan na/ rang gi 'od zer 'phros pas/ sa bon gsum po las 'od kyis lcags kyus btab pas rang dbang med par 'dus par bsam mo// sngags ni gzhi snying gcig tu dril go bzlog la bzlas te/ 'di la mang mi dgos gsung so// rtsa ba'i gdams pa 'di yod na las tshogs kun gang byas kyang mi 'grub pa med/ ye shes mgon po btsun pa'am dge slong pho mo bstan pa dang*/ las mgon mi nag po la sogs pa

dang lha mo'i bud med rgyan can la sogs pa rtags 'char/ sku rtags rab lung ston pa/ rmi lam du 'bring tha ma dga' mi dga' rnams gsal bar 'ong ngo*// rtags phyi bya rog nang snying nang gsang ba nang rol / sku mthong gsung thos thugs kyi rtags dang*/ gtso 'khor sbrel ma'am rtags rnams gsal bar 'char bar 'gyur ro// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i zhal gdams yi ger bkod pa bzod par gsol lo// de ltar byung na dga' mi dga'i bsam pa spangs/ de yin min shan 'byed pa la/ de yang bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*/ yi dam lha tshogs thams cad dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad dang*/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad dang*/ chos skyong lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/ 'di chos skyong gi rtags yin na gsal ba dang mang bar gyur cig /bgegs kyi cho 'phrul yin na brlag pa dang zhi bar gyur cig /bka' rgya yod do/// /oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswa hā/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du byon/ maṅga laṃ/// /
